newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SanMig bottling unit plans new facility.
newsitem.headline: SanMig bottling unit plans new facility.

text.p: Rightpak International Corp, a subsidiary of San Miguel Corp, is planning to build a 245 million peso bottling plant, documents submitted to the Board of Investments on Monday showed.
The bottling plant will manufacture refillable plastic bottles which can fill hot beverages such as juice, tea, energy drinks and food products such as pickles and preserves.
The plant will be able to manufacture 28,094,000 bottles every year.
The new plant will be located in Laguna, just south of Manila.
